title: The sequential telescope cokernel is the colimit
statement: For any cochain sequence F with transitions u [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], the cokernel of identity minus shift [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map], with injections F_n -> sum(F) -> cokernel(delta), is a colimit of the sequence.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; The sequential telescope cokernel is the colimit.

proof.text: A compatible family out of F induces a unique map out of sum(F). On each coproduct injection, its composite with identity minus shift is q_n-u_n;q_(n+1), which is zero. Descend through the cokernel. The coproduct and cokernel universal properties give factorization and uniqueness.
